title: MV/MZ RPG Player - A Universal HTML5 Online Game Player adapted for RPG Maker MV

posts.author: RyanBram
posts.body:

Hi everyone — let's celebrate!
RPG Maker MV turned 10 years old — a decade of creativity, unforgettable projects, and a thriving community. To honor that milestone, I'm excited to introduce RPG Player. A sleek HTML5 game player designed to present and play games like an online media player — fast to embed, easy for players, and friendly for developers and publishers.
What is RPG Player?​
RPG Player is a ready-made HTML5 game player UI that wraps any compatible game engine output and presents it like a modern web media player. Think of it as a lightweight player chrome for games: cover art, play controls, virtual gamepad, and display modes — all out of the box.
Why you’ll love it​
Instant professionalism:
adds a familiar, polished UI around your game so players jump right in.
Minimal setup:
drop the required files on your server and point to your game assets — no extra coding required.
Engine-agnostic:
works with any HTML5-based game engine or exported build that uses standard web technologies.
Flexible licensing:
place on personal pages or commercial websites.
Key features​
Cover art screen shown before the game loads, perfect for branding and first impressions.
Playback controls: Play, Reload, Stop, Fullscreen, and Volume control — all with keyboard and touch support.
Built-in virtual gamepad for touch devices — out-of-the-box on-screen controls so mobile players can play comfortably.
Zero-code integration for RPG Maker MV: load the player and the required files and your game runs — no plugin or extra scripts necessary.
Automatic orientation adaptivity: the player intelligently adapts its layout between landscape and portrait modes, optimizing controls and viewport for mobile devices.
Embed anywhere: designed to be placed on personal sites, storefronts, or commercial pages.
Engine support: compatible with any HTML5 game engine that delivers a standard web build (Canvas, WebGL, etc.).
Designed for creators and publishers​
RPG Player was built to make it easy to present playable demos, host full builds, and provide a consistent experience across devices:
Fast preview for playtesters and press.
Demo pages for marketplaces and portfolios.
Player template for web kiosks or storefront hero sections.
Accessibility & UX​
Touch-friendly controls and virtual gamepad for mobile players.
Automatic orientation adaptivity: layout and controls adapt automatically when the device orientation changes (landscape ↔ portrait), giving a comfortable play experience on phones and tablets.
Volume control and mute for quick testing and user comfort.
Commercial & distribution​
Suitable for personal portfolios, promotional pages, and commercial storefronts.
Minimal dependencies and lightweight assets to keep page load fast.
Part of
RPG Maker MV Ace
​
RPG Player
is part of the RPG Maker MV Ace project — an effort to modernize the MV engine with current web technologies and meaningful quality-of-life improvements for game developers.
Learn more on the
RPG MV Ace project page
.
How you can help​
Your support keeps projects like this alive. Here’s how you can make a difference today:
Share the plugin in community spaces: share demos, post showcases, and spread the word.
